verdict.rationale: Vanta has dedicated first-party product pages for HIPAA (automated evidence, Security and Breach Notification Rule coverage), GDPR (privacy workflows and continuous monitoring) and PCI (reuse controls in one place). Its homepage cites SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA and 35+ frameworks, and the GRC product cross-maps controls across pre-built frameworks, so new frameworks are added within the same platform. A community note that pricing scales with the number of frameworks indirectly corroborates multi-framework use on one platform. Missing for 10: PCI DSS-specific depth (the PCI page snippets are generic), and independent or hands-on corroboration of HIPAA/GDPR/PCI coverage quality.
